info.title: API.SH: RateMyProfessors
info.description: The RateMyProfessors API from API.SH: public RateMyProfessors data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Two or three professors side by side: school, department, overall quality, difficulty, would-take-again share, rating distribution, top tags and courses, with who rates highest, easiest and most would-take-again.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.description: 2 or 3 professor ids or professor links, comma-separated.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Professors matching a name, within one school or across all: name, department, overall quality, number of ratings, difficulty, would-take-again share, school and profile link, plus the total match count and department filter values. The site shows the first 5 matches to logged-out visitors; `has_more` says whether there are more.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ratemyprofessors-professors

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A professor's name (or part of it).

parameters.name: school_id
parameters.description: The school's id (the number in ratemyprofessors.com/school/<id>).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
All of a professor's RateMyProfessors ratings, newest first, 20 per page: course, date, quality, clarity, helpfulness, difficulty, would take again, grade, attendance, textbook, online, for credit, tags, text, thumbs up and down and the professor's reply. Also the professor's summary (department, school, overall rating, difficulty, would-take-again share, number of ratings) and the courses rated with their counts; pass a course code as `course` to see only that course's ratings. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ratemyprofessors-ratings

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The professor's id (the number in ratemyprofessors.com/professor/<id>) or that URL.

parameters.name: course
parameters.description: Only ratings for this course code, e.g. `MATH221` (see `courses` in the response).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
